blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-08-08. Verified sources and ABIs for Ethereum, Base, Optimism, Arbitrum, and Berachain expose no local holder blacklist, freeze, pause, seizure, or transfer-stop method. sDOLA is nevertheless a tracked 100% DOLA savings-passthrough variant, and its parent DOLA has a confirmed direct holder-control posture. Variant inheritance therefore resolves sDOLA as Upstream; the prior explicit false override incorrectly suppressed the parent relationship. Rechecked parent identity at Ethereum block 26098749 on 2026-10-01: canonical asset() returns DOLA 0x865377367054516e17014ccded1e7d814edc9ce4. At BSC block 125135317, the tracked parent DOLA representation permits burn(address(1),0) from its enabled minter 0x58892974758a4013377a45fad698d2ff1f08d98e and rejects an unrelated caller. The inherited verdict is retained on current parent-control evidence; this does not assert local holder controls on sDOLA.

oracleRisk.summary: sDOLA is an ERC-4626 savings wrapper around DOLA and has no borrower-owned collateral positions or token-level liquidation engine. Its underlying DOLA exposure inherits the external FiRM oracle risk reviewed on the parent asset.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex external-a oracle applicability review
branchApplicability.rationale: sDOLA holders do not open FiRM borrower positions, so sDOLA has no local collateral-market or liquidation branches and DOLA retains its separate parent review. The ERC-4626 wrapper nevertheless mints and redeems shares at a DOLA:sDOLA exchange rate that rises as streamed DBR rewards are converted into DOLA, making that vault quote a price-sensitive top-level authority.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: sDOLA minting, unwrapping, and yield accrual operate on Ethereum. Inverse reports that governance mill 396 shut down all sDOLA Chainlink CCIP lanes on 2026-08-11. At pinned blocks read 2026-10-01, the Ethereum, Base, Optimism, Arbitrum, and Berachain pools each returned an empty supported-chain list. Peripheral token contracts remain historical burn-mint representations; they are not live CCIP destinations.

routes.reviewNote: sDOLA is native on Ethereum. The historical CCIP LockReleaseTokenPool 0x05eEe76f456C51Be0459EC1c0a78bf177B2c877C returned no supported chains at Ethereum block 26095807. Inverse reports that mill 396 closed the sDOLA CCIP lanes on 2026-08-11; the prior lock-release route is no longer available.

Historical sDOLA burn-mint representation. The prior 2026-07-20 review simulated minting from the CCIP pool. Inverse reports that mill 396 closed all sDOLA CCIP lanes on 2026-08-11. Rechecked Base block 52041917 on 2026-10-01: the pool returns no supported chains, and mint(address,uint256) of 1e18 from the pool reverts msg.sender not minter. Both token and pool owner() return governance proxy 0x1c064265e053d23d120c518fdbb542e6537f82d1; setMinter(address,bool) from that owner succeeds in eth_call. The proxy's allowedSender() is Ethereum GovernanceSender 0x4e521fe7a9084067096d45a312b8feee39d5f1f3 and allowedSourceChain() is 5009297550715157269. The token pool has no separate rate-limit admin. Current CCIP transfer and pool mint permissions are disabled, but owner re-authorization remains; no zero-risk or zero-supply conclusion is implied.
